PURPOSE 2.1 The Operating Instruction (OI) details and implements the Acquisition by Qualified Options (AQO) framework for complex acquisition programmes undertaken by the NSPA Acquisition Directorate under the NSPO Partnership framework . The OI is subordinate to Reference A and the specific objectives of this framework are to: 2.1.1 implement the fundamental principles of fairness, openness, transparency and non - discrimination that underlie NATO and NSPO p rocurement; 2.1.2 establish a flexible, adaptable but robust framework for acquisition programmes that involve the development and acquisition of complex and/or innovative capabilities and platforms; and, 2.1.3 give acquiring Partnership Member Nations clear avenues for input and decision at appropriate points in time, hence promoting trust and cooperation between Partnership Member Nations in a complex, high - level and high - stakes acquisition programme.
